---
description: Create or refine a newcoder spec
---

Create or refine a newcoder spec.

1. Run `newcoder spec new <name> --describe "<what the feature must do>"` to draft requirements in EARS.
2. After the team approves requirements.md (status: approved), run `newcoder spec design <name>`,
   and after the design is approved, `newcoder spec tasks <name>`.
3. Run `newcoder spec lint <name>` and fix every problem it reports.
